SELECT P_DEPT_NM, DEPT_NM AS TEXT1, DEPT_CD AS CODE FROM KEP.KEP_MIS_CODE WHERE 1=1
AND F_DATE BETWEEN #{SEARCH}||'01' AND #{SEARCH}||'12'
AND F_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') || '01' AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') || '12'
GROUP BY P_DEPT_NM, DEPT_NM, DEPT_CD ORDER BY P_DEPT_NM, DEPT_NM
